dedupe_keys.name: lattice boltzmann computational code for modelling of water sorption and transport in cement hydrates with dynamic microstructure

description: Peter McDonald and Miryea Nicole Borg publish MATLAB code for simulating water sorption and transport in cement hydrates with changing microstructure. Zenodo provides a public source archive, short text note and sample output under CC BY 4.0. The description links the implementation to a Cement and Concrete Research paper and states that the script reproduces its computational ideas. This model can test moisture transport assumptions relevant to concrete durability and built-infrastructure ageing. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this lattice-Boltzmann material calculation. Coverage is the modelled cement-hydrate microstructure, not observed condition of a particular bridge or building. A limitation is that translating pore-scale moisture behaviour to structural-scale deterioration needs separate geometry, exposure and calibration. The public page does not specify all boundary conditions or a validated runtime environment. No file was downloaded, MATLAB was not run and no sorption curve was reproduced.
